channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Two men seriously injured in separate traffic accidents
item.description: Two men are seriously injured in separate traffic accidents in Żurrieq and Marsaskala on Thursday morning

item.title: Government expands high-priority scholarships for social work students
item.description: The government announces new high-priority and prescribed scholarships at the University of Malta and MCAST to support students training as social workers

item.title: Court finds State breached Robert Aquilina’s fundamental rights, orders compensation
item.description: Civil Court finds State guilty of breaching the fundamental rights of notary and ex-Repubblika President Robert Aquilina over unfair treatment at hands of tribunal deciding on freedom of information requests for list of police nominees to FIAU board during Lawrence Cutajar's time as police commissioner

item.title: Updated | ARMS rejects PN claim that 50,000 accounts were affected by billing error
item.description: ARMS insists only a small percentage of customers were impacted by the eco-contribution issue, as it waits for the outcome of an independent audit ordered by the ministry

item.title: Government pledges support and regeneration projects after storm damage
item.description: Prime Minister Robert Abela says government will help affected families and businesses and launch regeneration works in coastal areas hit by Storm Harry

item.title: Man given probation and treatment order over Marsa stabbing
item.description: The 25-year-old was charged in 2022 for stabbing another man near his home in Marsa

item.title: Voluntary organisations affected by Storm Harry urged to register for government support
item.description: Voluntary groups that suffered damage during this week’s storm are being asked to submit claims so assistance can be assessed and allocated

item.title: Delayed murder trials deny victims timely justice, Daphne Foundation warns
item.description: The Daphne Foundation says systemic court delays are leaving families waiting years for justice, after a wilful homicide case went to trial 17 years after the killing

item.title: Property Price Registry launched to boost transparency in housing market
item.description: A new registry based on verified contract data aims to give buyers, banks and policymakers clearer insight into real property values in Malta and Gozo

item.title: Planning board to decide on demolition of Shell fuel depot
item.description: The Planning Authority’s case officer has recommended approval for the dismantling and demolition of the former 31st March petroleum installation in Birżebbuġa
